observed_value: two extracted PRIVATE_CREDIT rows with blank interest_rate and basis_spread
anchor_value: continuation rows are not separate positions; the immediately preceding source rows carry the instrument identity and stated PIK rate

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Blank continuation line repeats amortized cost 3,033, fair value 2,995, and 0.38%; preceding row 16 is GTCR BC Intermediate II, Inc., Subordinated Unsecured Term Loan, 12.75% PIK.
Blank continuation line repeats amortized cost 4,906, fair value 4,838, and 0.61%; preceding row 19 is OEC Holdco, LLC, Subordinated Unsecured Term Loan, 11.00% PIK.

findings.detail: Two blank schedule continuation lines were materialized as separate PRIVATE_CREDIT positions, producing the two X02 rows with missing rates.

rationale: The raw investment schedule shows that the flagged blank-rate records correspond to blank continuation lines, not independent loans. Each line repeats only the numeric carrying values of the named, rate-bearing loan immediately above it. The source therefore supports one GTCR loan at 12.75% PIK and one OEC loan at 11.00% PIK, while the extra blank-rate records are structural duplicates. X02 is detecting real bad rows, with deduplication as the appropriate remediation class.
